title: WA UTC Docket 260496 — Order - Other: Order 01 Granting Less Than Statutory Notice.
summary: Order 01 Granting Less Than Statutory Notice.
text:
SPECIAL FUEL SURCHARGE SUPPLEMENT NO. 14 
Applies on Carrier’s Tariff No. 8 
The Commission approves a temporary 1.09% fuel surcharge in all rates and 
charges as a result of increased fuel costs incurred by the company during the 
month of May 2026, to be collected from customers as a separate line item on 
the billing, as follows: 
Customers who are billed monthly for services in arrears: 
The fuel surcharge applies to all services provided in the month of July 2026.
